_comment: One entry per operating mode: LOW_ENERGY, CRITICAL_TASK1, CRITICAL_TASK2, BOTH_CRITICAL, in that order -- the order matches the 4 hardcoded case blocks in DynMultiDeeployTest/Platforms/DynSiracusa/src/dynmultideeploytest_template.c, which is NOT yet generated from this file (that's Phase 3). variant0/cores0/l1_0/v0 = models_name[0] (Task 2, e.g. TinyClassifier); variant1/cores1/l1_1/v1 = models_name[1] (Task 1, e.g. AnomalyDetection). v0/v1 are the single-letter variant tags ('s'/'l') used by DynMultiDeeploy/SourceFusion.py's fuse_network_c() to name each mode's RunNetworks_v0_v1_n0_n1/InitNetworks_v0_v1_n0_n1 entry points.
